text:
Jordan W: incident-bot just paged infra-oncall for a PROD latency alert, but the alert is for api.redwood.com - I think this got routed to the wrong PD service. Paging chain started 14:04 UTC
IncidentBot: PagerDuty incident created: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 - priority: P1 - triggered by monitor: api-5xx-error-rate
Maya R: acking to stop duplicate noise while we triage. I'm on it.
Samir P: @Maya R, can you confirm which service the PD link points to? It should be "api-service" not "infra-service"
Maya R: PD link points to service ID "infra-service". Looks like the alert rule's service tag is "infra" currently.
Leo K: customers are seeing increased 502s. Support dashboard shows ~120 failed requests in the last 10m, mostly from EU region. Not widespread but customer-facing.
Samir P: stepping through the flow — our monitoring rule has a field "service_tag: api" but the alert webhook translates to PD service via a mapping table. That mapping was last updated in Dec.
Jordan W: quick mitigation: can we reassign the incident to the correct PD service and re-route future alerts to api-service?
Samir P: I'm going to reassign the incident now. Running: ```pdcli incidents reassign PD12345 --to-service api-service --note "misrouted by mapping mismatch"```
IncidentBot: Incident PD12345 reassigned to api-service by Samir P
ScheduleBot: FYI the oncall schedule tagged as "api" was renamed to "api-v2" in the schedule system yesterday (change ID SCHED-809). Mapping still expects "api".
Maya R: that rename explains it — monitoring webhook uses schedule tag to pick PD service. If mapping didn't catch the rename, alerts go to fallback (infra-service).
Jordan W: who approved the rename? We need rollback or mapping update.
Samir P: I see the change log: Samir P approved SCHED-809 in infra-console yesterday 18:12 UTC (we forgot to update the alert mapping).
Leo K: immediate customer impact: a subset of API clients saw 502s for ~12 minutes while the first responder was delayed because page went to infra team. Some customers opened support tickets. Severity: moderate.
Maya R: mitigation steps done: 1) reassigned PD incident 2) routed live alerts to api-service 3) created temporary PD rule to route any alerts with tag "api-v2" -> api-service 4) support notified customers with status update.
Samir P: permanent fix: update mapping table and add end-to-end test that verifies an alert from api monitor lands in api-service. I'll open PR and a config migration to map old and new tags for 30d.
Jordan W: can we show the PD event log snippet here for postmortem?
Samir P: paste from PD event stream: ```
[14:03:21] alert webhook received: monitor=api-5xx-error-rate tags=["api-v2"]
[14:03:22] lookup mapping for tag "api-v2" -> no match
[14:03:22] fallback mapping -> infra-service
[14:03:23] PagerDuty: incident created PD12345 on infra-service
[14:15:10] manual reassignment PD12345 -> api-service (Samir P)
```
Maya R: timeline for ops: page fired 14:03, first infra ack ~14:04, infra realized not their pager ~14:09, Samir reassigned 14:15, traffic normalized ~14:16-14:20.
Leo K: Support notified impacted customers at 14:22 with workaround and ETA. No data exfiltration, only availability impact for a small subset.
Jordan W: immediate action items: Samir PR to update mapping (P0), add alert-to-PD e2e test (P1), update runbook to detect schedule renames (P1). Maya will draft customer postmortem note.
Maya R: assigning owners: Samir -> mapping PR + tests, Jordan -> runbook update (quick checks on schedule rename), Leo -> customer communications and ticket triage. I'll run a quick post-incident checklist now.
Samir P: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/429 - includes a migration script: ```
# migration: map api-v2 -> api-service
update mapping set pd_service='api-service' where tag in ('api-v2','api')
```
Jordan W: will schedule a short postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC, invite: eng-sre, platform, support, and product.
Maya R: closing notes: made pager rule tolerant to unknown tags for next 72h (send to api-service + alert ops on mismatch). Monitor will be in watch mode for 24h.
IncidentBot: Incident PD12345 marked resolved by Maya R (resolution: reassigned and routing fixed)
Leo K: leaving a short summary on the ticket and pinging customers who opened support cases.
Samir P: long term recommendation: add validate-on-deploy for schedule renames and an automated mapping sync between schedules and PD mapping. Filing a follow-up ticket: OPS-1102.
Jordan W: thanks all. No further action for tonight after the follow-up tickets are tracked. :thumbsup:
